setup_cmd: T="$HOME/arm-gnu-10.3"; if [ ! -x "$T/bin/arm-none-eabi-gcc" ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget bzip2 make && wget -q https://developer.arm.com/-/media/Files/downloads/gnu-rm/10.3-2021.10/gcc-arm-none-eabi-10.3-2021.10-x86_64-linux.tar.bz2 -O /tmp/agt.tar.bz2 && mkdir -p "$T" && tar -xjf /tmp/agt.tar.bz2 -C "$T" --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/agt.tar.bz2; fi && echo "$T/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
